name: Shared Cleanup — Finish Group
intent: Shared cleanup for a finish_group_assignment pass: final inspect, final touchup, protection teardown, wall masking removal (spray only). Fires ONCE per group. Per-substrate MOD_CLEANUP_TRIM_PAINT instances gate off via applies_when: { pass_group_id: [null] }. Mirrors MOD_CLEANUP_TRIM_PAINT task list.
doctrine: V1a finish_group_assignment shared cleanup. Task_refs mirror MOD_CLEANUP_TRIM_PAINT exactly. Final inspect fires once at group level rather than per member — rationale: the inspect covers the visual continuity of the combined pass, not per-substrate acceptance.
